title: Trinity flash explained away as an ammo dump accident

tellings.quote: wondering what had happened and then the government saying, "Oh, we had a accident in an ammo dump."

plain: When the first atomic bomb was tested in New Mexico in 1945, people who saw the flash wondered what had happened, and the government told them it had been an accident at an ammunition dump. The physicist John Brandenburg tells this to Michels as something passed on to him. It is a story about the government covering a secret with a ready-made explanation.
